Job Title: Homeroom Teacher (Early Years / Key Stage 1)

International Community Schools (ICS) Al Manhal, a British curriculum school in Abu Dhabi, is seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Homeroom Teacher for our Early Years / Key Stage 1 programme. We are looking for an inspiring educator committed to creating a dynamic and supportive learning environment aligned with the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) framework and the National Curriculum for England, as appropriate to the assigned year group.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education, Primary Education, or a directly related field from an accredited university. A Master’s degree in a relevant educational field is highly advantageous.
Certification: Valid and internationally recognised teaching qualification or certification. Qualified Teacher Status (QTS), or an equivalent recognised teaching qualification, is strongly preferred.
Minimum of 2–3 years of full-time, post-qualification teaching experience as a Homeroom or Class Teacher within an Early Years or Key Stage 1 setting.
Demonstrated and recent experience delivering the EYFS framework and/or the National Curriculum for England in a reputable school environment.
Previous experience working in an international school setting is highly desirable.

Pedagogical Excellence: Excellent classroom management skills, a strong command of differentiated teaching strategies, and proficiency in planning age-appropriate learning activities and assessments. Ability to balance play-based learning with structured teaching according to pupils’ developmental stages.

Technological Proficiency: Competence in using educational technology, including interactive whiteboards, Learning Management Systems, Google Workspace for Education, and Microsoft 365, to enhance learning and engagement.
Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English, enabling effective interaction with pupils, parents, and colleagues from diverse cultural backgrounds.
Collaboration & Teamwork: A proactive team player who collaborates effectively with colleagues, contributes to curriculum development, and participates in whole-school initiatives.
Personal Attributes: Patience, creativity, adaptability, cultural sensitivity, and a strong commitment to the holistic development and wellbeing of young children.
In-depth understanding and proven ability to plan, deliver, and assess learning within the EYFS framework and/or the National Curriculum for England, as appropriate to the assigned year group.
Strong knowledge of early language development, systematic synthetic phonics, early reading and writing, and foundational mathematics.
Familiarity with observation-based assessment, formative assessment, progress tracking, and reporting practices relevant to Early Years and Key Stage 1.
Proficiency in creating engaging, play-based and enquiry-led learning experiences that develop curiosity, independence, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to meet all applicable teacher licensing and approval criteria set by the Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge (ADEK).
Familiarity with ADEK inspection frameworks, educational policies, and guidelines applicable to private schools in Abu Dhabi.
Compliance with applicable UAE visa requirements and successful completion of required background checks and police clearances.
Understanding and respect for Emirati culture and traditions, with the ability to incorporate culturally relevant learning experiences where appropriate.

عندما تنضم إلى عائلة شيراتون، تصبح عضوًا في مجتمعها العالمي. لقد كنا مكانًا للتجمع والتواصل منذ عام 1937. في شيراتون، يخلق الموظفون شعورًا بالانتماء في أكثر من 400 مجتمع حول العالم. نحن ندعو ونرحب ونربط الضيوف من خلال تجارب جذابة وخدمة مدروسة. إذا كنت تحب العمل في فريق ومتحمسًا لتقديم تجربة ضيف ذات مغزى، فنحن نشجعك على استكشاف فرصتك المهنية التالية مع شيراتون.انضم إلينا في مهمتنا لنكون «مكان التجمع العالمي». عند الانضمام إلى فنادق ومنتجعات شيراتون، فإنك تنضم إلى مجموعة من العلامات التجارية مع ماريوت الدولية. كن في المكان الذي يمكنك فيه القيام بأفضل أعمالك، وابدأ هدفك ، وانتمي إلى فريق عالمي مذهل ، لتصبح أفضل نسخة منك.
